bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATOR_RUNTIME_READ_ONLY\n'
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf 'CHECKOUT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CHECKOUT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'CHECKOUT_DIRTY_COUNT='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'CREATOR_CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -E 'videobot|create-videobot' || true
printf 'LOCAL_BOT_API\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -E 'telegram-bot-api|bot-api' || true
